title: Tate endomorphism ideals and traces of mixed commutators
statement:
Let $k$ be a field, $V$ a $k$-vector space and $A\subset V$ a $k$-linear subspace. Write $X\prec Y$ for $\dim_k((X+Y)/Y)<\infty$. Define subspaces of $\operatorname{End}_k(V)$ by
$$E=\{T:T(A)\prec A\},\quad E_1=\{T:T(V)\prec A\},\quad E_2=\{T:\dim_kT(A)<\infty\},\quad E_0=E_1\cap E_2.$$
Then $E$ is a unital $k$-subalgebra; $E_1,E_2$ are two-sided ideals in $E$, and $E_1+E_2=E$. Every product $ST$ with $S\in E_2$ and $T\in E_1$ has finite-dimensional image. In particular each element of $E_0$ is finite-potent, and its finite-potent trace [lem-pc-finite-potent-trace-calculus] is a $k$-linear function on $E_0$. If either $(S,T)\in E_0\times E$ or $(S,T)\in E_1\times E_2$, then $[S,T]=ST-TS\in E_0$ and $\operatorname{Tr}_{\mathrm{fp}}([S,T])=0$.
